main_issue: How to get D's half-finished analysis section done by Thursday given D's bereavement: D working tonight versus A taking over with B reviewing and C helping.

A-B.evidence: A asks B to review (9); B agrees: 'I can review it tomorrow afternoon' (10); A thanks B (11). B had earlier refused to take on more (4).

A-C.evidence: C refused D's section (5), then agrees to help with slides after finishing own part (12, 19); A pushes for timing (18).

A-D.evidence: D proposes working tonight (6, 13), A refuses (7, 14); D yields: 'Okay, Agent A. If you're sure' (15) and 'I'll leave it with you' (20); A: 'We'll handle it' (21).

B-C.evidence: Both initially said they could not take on more (4, 5); both later accept limited roles in A's plan (10, 12). They never address each other.

B-D.evidence: B only agrees to review (10) and never speaks to D. D ends up accepting the team plan (20).

C-D.evidence: D voices worry about C being behind (13, 15); C replies 'Don't worry about my part' (17). D then accepts the plan and thanks everyone (20).
